choices.reason: The paper states "We test two primary hypotheses" and H2 explicitly specifies High-Agency versus Control and versus Low-Agency. Of the tied AI-versus-control candidates, only High-Agency versus Control matches that named primary contrast, so rule 1 resolves the tie.
